structure.note: MarkItDown emits Markdown only, so node/page/sheet counts are not comparable. DocWeave's counts describe its intermediate representation.

accuracy.ground_truth: Author-provided: every fixture is rendered from a declarative spec in tests/ground_truth.py, so the expected extraction is exact by construction.
accuracy.scope: Synthetic, author-controlled corpus: known boundaries, no scanning noise, no font substitution. This is a lower bound on real-world accuracy and not a substitute for a labelled public corpus.
caveats: CER alone hides omission and invention; word recall and word precision are reported alongside it for exactly that reason.
Container coverage is only scored for DocWeave, which exposes an intermediate representation; MarkItDown has no equivalent to score.
A document with no ground-truth text (a scan) scores 0 for any system that reports text, because inventing text is scored as error.
